command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== ACTIVE FRANKENSTEIN UNITS IN CONTAINER ==='; systemctl -M entityos --no-pager --no-legend --plain list-units 'frankenstein-*' --type=service --state=running 2>&1 || true; echo '=== UNIT PIDS/EXECS/ENV ==='; for u in $(systemctl -M entityos --no-legend --plain list-units 'frankenstein-*' --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do echo UNIT:$u; systemctl -M entityos show "$u" -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p Environment -p FragmentPath --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; pid=$(systemctl -M entityos show "$u" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true); if test "${pid:-0}" -gt 0 && sudo -n test -r /proc/$pid/environ 2>/dev/null; then sudo -n tr '\0' '\n' </proc/$pid/environ | grep -E '^(HOME|FRANKENSTEIN_(CONSCIOUSNESS_DB|UNIFIED_DB|INNENWELT_DB)|WELT_DB_PATH)=' || true; fi; done; echo '=== OPEN DB HOLDERS WITH CGROUP ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do echo DB:$p; sudo -n lsof -t "$p" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | while read -r pid; do test -n "$pid" || continue; printf 'PID=%s CMD=' "$pid"; sudo -n tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null || true; echo; cat /proc/$pid/cgroup 2>/dev/null | tail -3 || true; done; done; echo '=== SOURCE DEFAULTS ==='; grep -R -n -E 'consciousness\.db|world_experience\.db|amygdala\.db|FRANKENSTEIN_INNENWELT_DB|FRANKENSTEIN_CONSCIOUSNESS_DB' /var/lib/entityos/voice --include='*.py' 2>/dev/null | head -240
